propositions: Op-cert per-job boto3/SSM/region lookup couples app config to one secret store and creates concurrency/cleanup hazards; startup binding of a single immutable signer eliminates per-job state patching.
Exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY must be provided and validated (readable, regular file, Ed25519, 0600-or-stricter) before queue/worker/network/workspace creation.
The validated key is copied to a process-owned 0700 directory with 0600 file permissions, never modified/deleted during process lifetime, and observes replacement only after restart.

Both out-of-opcert_service/ signing producer chains (completion via transition_close.sign_completion_verdict and plan-review via attest/generation) must accept and forward an optional context-local OpcertSigner binding, with concurrent/timed-out jobs proving signer/principal/push isolation.

The op-cert application runtime removes SSM/boto3/region dependency: compose carries no REBAR_OPCERT_SSM_KEY_PARAM, the image has no runtime boto3, and fetch-secrets.sh materializes the 0600 key file before container start.
Developer-local close/review-plan callers without an injected signer binding must retain prior env/genesis-based resolution unchanged as a regression pin.
